messages.text: Happy to check. What's the email on the order?
Handed to the team · No ship date on the remaining line and it is far past due

Most of that order was delivered on March 4: the Hammer Scrypt miner, the Goldshell BYTE case and the two DG cards. USPS tracking: (tracking link hidden)

The one piece still outstanding is the Goldshell Byte Power Supply. It's out of stock at our Tennessee warehouse and I don't have a ship date for it, and I'm sorry nobody wrote to you about that. I've pinged the team for the real date. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in, or it comes to your email.
Ok yes thank I was wondering about the power supply

Understood, that's the one piece outstanding. The team will come back with a firm date for it, here or by email.

Anything else I can check while you're here?
Before you go, one thing: you were weighing a few miners today, what's making it hard to pick between them?
Price vs cost vs revenue or chance of hitting a block

Fair way to frame it. Two of ours lead on both counts: the Magic Miner 40T at $799 is about $20 per TH, the Harlo B30 at $899 is about $30 per TH. More hash for your dollar means both a better sats rate and better block odds, since solo odds scale straight with hashrate. The small Bitaxe-class units cost more per TH, so they're fun rather than efficient.

Want me to run the numbers for McConnells power rates on those two?
No problem. The team will be back to you on the power supply date, here or by email.

Glad to help, Jeff. You're welcome to join our Discord for product news and hands-on help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Take care.
